title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct e.m.f. value of 1.23 V.

title: Gibbs Function
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the relationship between Gibbs free energy and e.m.f. in the context of the reaction.

title: Thermodynamic Values
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly use the given enthalpy and entropy values for the calculation.

title: Chemical Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must write the balanced chemical equation for the reaction occurring in the fuel cell.

title: Calculation Steps
description: Optional Criteria: The student should show clear steps in the calculation leading to the final answer.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common mistakes such as incorrect signs in enthalpy or entropy values.

title: Charge Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the total charge involved in the reaction (2F).
